competition.prizeinfo: A collection of Times reference books — The Times  Reference  Atlas, Collins English Dictionary & Thesaurus, and Bradford’s Crossword Solver’s Dictionary, published by HarperCollins —  will be awarded for the first randomly selected correct solution.
